claim.statement: Fault injection is guarded by --acknowledge, a role (Deployer for workload faults, Admin for node faults), an operator opt-in in [testing].allowed_operations on each node, a safety_class (production and unknown also need allow_protected_mutation), and rails that refuse faults that would take out every replica or put council quorum at risk.

claim.measurable: On a server-installed cluster every relish fault is refused; after setting [testing] allowed_operations = ["inject_workload_faults"] and safety_class = "development" workload faults work but node-kill does not; kill web --count 3 on a three-replica app is refused; pause without --instance is refused; node-pressure needs a non-zero max_node_pressure_* and memory caps at 90 percent; every injection, clear and expiry is in relish audit --action 'fault.*'; fault.injected with override_safety is recorded as critical.
